summary: The MaintProgramProfileDescription user control manages program profile descriptions, allowing users to view, add, edit, and delete individual program details. It supports both editable and read-only modes, handles modal display of details, and provides business logic for sorting, validation, and conditional UI behaviors.
purpose: To facilitate maintenance of program profile descriptions within an administrative interface, supporting CRUD operations, modal detail editing, contextual help, and governing access/edit modes through user session and program state.

workflows.name: View Profile Descriptions
steps: If the grid is empty and editable, show Add Empty Data button.
Modal popup opens for detail viewing/editing.

workflows.name: Add/Edit/Delete Profile Description
steps: User chooses to edit or add via grid row commands.
Switch to edit/add mode in FormView.
Form fields are populated; dropdowns set by HeadingID.
On save, validate fields and submit to ProgramDetail (add or update).
After changes, redirect to profile list with correct permissions and tab.

workflows.name: Delete Profile Description
steps: ProgramDetail deletes record using UserSession context.

business_rules: Only editable if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Grid Setup buttons adapt based on editability.
SortOrder defaults to '-1' if not specified.
Delete and Edit buttons shown only in appropriate mode.
Empty data add button shown if no data and screen is editable.
validations: ValidationSummary3 control used for displaying validation errors.
SortOrder input checked for emptiness and set to '-1' if missing.
HeadingID and Response required for save.
calculations: SortOrder: if empty, defaults to -1 and then converted to integer.
conditions: If control is not visible, cancel ObjectDataSource selection.
Panel visibility for description fields depends on PD.HeaderChanged.
If grid rows count is zero and editable, show Add Empty Data panel.
On FormView data bound, disables edit fields if ScreenIsEditable is false.
system_behavior: Handles CRUD operations for program description.
Supports contextual help via Help.aspx with session query string.
Redirects after add/edit/delete to profile listing with user session persisted.
dependencies: Grid utility methods (SetupAddButton, SetupEditButton, SetupDeleteButton, SwitchToEditMode, SwitchToAddMode, ShowDetails, DisableEditFields)
ProgramDetails data access methods (GetByID, Add, Update, Delete)
exceptions: If ObjectDataSource selection is cancelled because control is not visible.
If empty data template causes event validation errors, manual workaround used.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for failed database operations.
No detailed field-level validation logic beyond SortOrder and required fields.
Business rules for user permissions are only implied via UserSession and ScreenIsEditable.
